sources.title: $\alpha$-attractor from superconformal E-models in brane inflation

evidence.text: Numerical ns and r predictions are compared with the analytic approximations and scanned over α and V0/λ. Additional n values are examined. Later parameter plots use N=60 and the historical Planck 2018 and BICEP2/Keck constraints cited by the paper.

sources.title: A note on supergravity inflation in braneworld

evidence.text: Numerical slow-roll predictions use the modified e-fold integral N=−∫(YV/V′)dϕ, with Y=1+V/(2λ), and the scalar and tensor spectra appropriate to RSII. The authors report ending inflation at ε=1 because |η| is smaller at the exit point.

sources.title: $\alpha$-attractor from superconformal E-models in brane inflation

evidence.text: For n=1, the high-energy e-fold relation is integrated and approximated at small exp(−βφ*), then inverted using the lower Lambert branch W−1. The end condition is estimated from the acceleration equation, giving ε(φe)=6/5 rather than the usual approximate ε=1.

sources.title: $\alpha$-attractor from superconformal E-models in brane inflation

evidence.text: The analysis uses brane-modified potential slow-roll parameters, the corresponding e-fold integral, and scalar/tensor spectra including the RSII tensor correction F². The scalar tilt is evaluated as ns−1=−6ε+2η.

sources.title: A note on supergravity inflation in braneworld

evidence.text: An analytic expansion in λ/α uses the exponential integral Ei to approximate N, n_s and r. The explicitly demonstrated reduction to one parameter is for m=n=1; this pass does not reconstruct the extracted formulas or their remainder terms.
